composed_text.description: Composed weekly CRM-surface body, ready for outbound.deliver. Up to 1000 chars — longer than a reminder because it digests several stale-contact parties. Empty string only on the on_failure defensive default (bypasses output-schema validation per [REFERENCE_EXAMPLES.md §3]).

suggested_channel.description: Channel hint into outbound.dispatcher; dispatcher decides actual channel from member preferences.

sort_order.description: Party ids in the suggested display order. MUST be a reorder of the input surfaced_parties ids; fabricated ids zero the message at the pipeline guard layer.
